scope: One uniquely owned isolated VPC, two private AZ subnets, no-ingress security group and two kafka.t3.small brokers with 1 GiB each; no public access, NAT, internet gateway, endpoints, producers or customer data. One owned role/function with reserved concurrency zero, disabled mappings, optional versions/aliases/dummy secret, one live stack/change set. Never create or modify shared service-linked roles. If AWSServiceRoleForKafka is absent, skip provisioning and capture absent-source admission only. Exact-owned resumable cleanup required.
observed_prerequisite: Fresh native GetRole AWSServiceRoleForKafka returned NoSuchEntity. This capture therefore uses only the reviewed no-broker admission fallback.
